title: Roommate: Ryouko in Summer Vacation
native_title: ルームメイト ～涼子イン・サマー・バケーション～
overview:
The summer vacation we spend together - what kind of memories will we carve into our hearts......

Inoue Ryouko, who now lives with her family in America, comes back to stay at your house for the summer holidays. Spend a week of everyday life with her in this real-time communication simulation, where events are tied to the Saturn's internal clock and unfold as the days actually pass.

The choices you make shape how close the two of you become and can lead to special events. Time together is not limited to the house: head out to places around town, including a playable game of tennis.

二人で過ごす夏休み、僕たちはどんな思い出を心に刻むのだろう……。
